name: Copilot Web Search
description: Routes web_search through GitHub Copilot's Bing-backed MCP endpoint, with LeakGuard egress on the query.

baseUrl.description: Copilot API base URL. If omitted, derived from the JWT proxy-ep claim at startup.

githubTokenKeychainService.description: macOS Keychain service for the GitHub PAT. Default 'openclaw' (matches mcp-hooks).

githubTokenKeychainAccount.description: macOS Keychain account for the GitHub PAT. Default 'github-pat' (matches mcp-hooks).

model.description: Copilot model used by LeakGuard for the egress check.

maxResults.description: Cap on results requested per query (passed to MCP arguments).

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for the MCP call.

auditLogPath.description: Override path for the JSONL audit log (default ~/.openclaw/logs/copilot-web-search-audit.jsonl).
